title: Phase 1 Consolidation — Starter Kit / Workbench Split
spec:
CONSOLIDATION ACTION: STARTER-WORKBENCH-SPLIT

The AgenticStarterKit (tools/agentic-starter-kit/) has evolved into two distinct things:
1. A reusable TEMPLATE for new agentic projects (starter kit)
2. An OPERATIONAL tool for managing delivery work (delivery-workbench)

These need to be separated so the starter kit stays clean for sharing.

TASK 1: Audit current overlap
- Read tools/agentic-starter-kit/ and tools/delivery-workbench/
- Identify files that are template-worthy (generic, reusable) vs operational (specific to michabr4's workflow)
- List which files belong where

TASK 2: Move operational files to delivery-workbench
- Any scripts, configs, or data specific to michabr4's projects → tools/delivery-workbench/
- Keep the starter kit generic: README, GETTING_STARTED, example configs, docs/, security rules
- Use cp first, then confirm before removing originals

TASK 3: Clean up starter kit for sharing
- Ensure no hardcoded paths, usernames, or project-specific references remain
- Verify .env.example has placeholder values only
- Confirm README is suitable for a new user who clones the repo

TASK 4: Update MASTER_INDEX.md
- Ensure both projects have correct descriptions reflecting the split
- Update status fields if needed

TASK 5: Report
- List all files moved
- List any files that were ambiguous (could go either way)
- Confirm both directories are self-contained and functional

Reference: CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md has the original spec for this action.
